observed_behavior: Submission accepted a clean candidate while interactive rebase remained paused at an edit stop.
expected_behavior: A worker must finish its semantic rebase before its candidate can enter review.
causal_mechanism: Git porcelain status is empty at a clean edit stop; HEAD and linear ancestry can already match the proposed candidate. Those checks do not establish that rebase has completed.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Candidate validation inferred operation completion from clean content and ancestry rather than inspecting Git's operation state.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An intermediate operation state can satisfy all content checks while still owning the checkout.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Neither Git rebase backend may have retained operation state at submission.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Resolve rebase-merge and rebase-apply through Git's absolute git-path lookup and reject retained state before candidate proof assessment.

applicability_conditions: Interactive rebase can pause with clean Git status
known_non_matches: The same candidate after rebase --continue has no retained rebase state and passes validation
confirmation_evidence: tmp/binding-selectors/worker-submission-state-before.txt: clean status and matching HEAD, but missing expected rejection
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-worker-submission.test.ts: submission rejects a clean interactive rebase edit stop until the rebase completes
